options.title: Always-on VPS

title: What should count as a high risk action?
summary: Atlas needs one product rule before it finalizes the approval-card policy.
details: The agent can detect obvious risks like external emails, production deploys, file deletion, payment, and calendar changes. It needs your preference for borderline cases.

input.placeholder: Example: Any action that sends, deletes, publishes, spends money, changes production, or contacts another person.
